lines.en: The trees shake when I take a step.
My cape drags through the mud.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可每一步都很沉。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but each step lands heavy.

lines.zh: 地上的草被我踩成一条沟。
lines.en: The grass flattens into a trench behind me.

lines.zh: 我低着头，往前一点点挪。
lines.en: Head down, I grind forward.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，鸟都闭了嘴。
lines.en: Where I pass, the birds shut up.

lines.zh: 庞大的身体让路显得很窄。
lines.en: With a body this size, every path feels narrow.
My breath comes out hot.

lines.zh: 我停下来系了系肩上的扣。
lines.en: I stop to fix the clasp on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 脚下泥土被我压出脚印深坑。
lines.en: My prints sink deep into the soil.
I stand and my chest rises slowly.

lines.zh: 风撞在我身上，散成两半。
lines.en: The wind splits in two against me.
I crack my knuckles.
I lift my eyes, then lower them again.

lines.zh: 绿气在皮肤下隐隐流动。
lines.en: Green light flickers faintly under my skin.
I wipe a hand across my face.
Something inside me feels like it's burning.

lines.zh: 我低下头，听着自己的心跳。
lines.en: I bow my head and listen to my own heartbeat.
The air around me feels thick.
I rotate my wrists slowly.

lines.zh: 我侧头看着自己的手掌。
lines.en: I tilt my head and look at my palm.
I keep holding it back.
Blades of grass snap one by one under me.
The slightest move makes my cape rustle.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，也敢站着。
lines.en: A thing this small, and it still stands.
Care to run first?

lines.zh: 你身上没有让我提起兴趣的东西。
lines.en: Nothing about you interests me.

lines.zh: 你想跟我说话，还是想被我撕开。
lines.en: Do you want to talk, or to be torn apart?
Even breathing is too loud for me.

lines.zh: 我俯视你，气流在脚边转。
lines.en: I look down on you, air swirling at my feet.
Your legs are trembling. Honest of them.
This place is too quiet.
Go ahead and try. I'm looking forward to it.
I'm standing here, so you're not leaving.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我的时候，像在祈祷。
lines.en: The way you look up at me looks like prayer.
I don't understand begging.

lines.zh: 你的眼神不错，有点意思。
lines.en: That look in your eyes. Interesting.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我一步就够了。
lines.en: At this range, one step is all I need.
Don't scream; I hate noise.
A little pain, like a mosquito bite.
I look at the wound and smile.
Blood runs down and dries fast.
I touch my ribs without thinking.
That had force. Not enough.
My breathing got coarser.

lines.zh: 这点疼，只让我的气更盛。
lines.en: This pain only makes my ki swell higher.

lines.zh: 我挣了一下，把力量收回来。
lines.en: I wrench myself back into control.
I take another step forward, not back.
Take it away; I don't eat that.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，倒像在喂牲口。
lines.en: Holding food up like feeding livestock.

lines.zh: 我饿过很久，但我不靠这个。
lines.en: I've been hungry a long time, but not for that.

lines.zh: 我看不出那有什么好吃。
lines.en: I can't see what's good about it.
Food doesn't interest me.

lines.zh: 你把它收起来，省得浪费。
lines.en: Put it away and stop wasting it.
I only want to fight.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的味道，比这个好。
lines.en: You carry a better scent than that.
Stop testing me with food.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一块岩壁。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a rock face.

lines.zh: 我只是站着，你就弹开了。
lines.en: I only stand, and you bounce off.
Don't walk against my feet.

lines.zh: 我的腿比你整个人都粗。
lines.en: My leg is thicker than your whole body.

lines.zh: 你被我一侧身挤得退了。
lines.en: A lean of my body and you retreat.

lines.zh: 我抬脚的时候，你要让开。
lines.en: When I lift my foot, move aside.

lines.zh: 肩膀一碰，你的护甲凹了。
lines.en: One shoulder touch, and your armor dents.
Your pack drops to the ground.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了你脚边的石头。
lines.en: I crush the stone beside your foot.
Stand firm; I don't want to step on you.
No one stands at my side.
Even my own kind backs away from me.

lines.zh: 我一个人走过整片荒野。
lines.en: I've crossed whole wastes alone.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我的力气收不住。
lines.en: Don't come close; I can't hold my strength back.

lines.zh: 我们彼此点头，就算打过招呼。
lines.en: A nod each way is greeting enough.
It stands half a head shorter.
We each hold a stretch of ruins.

lines.zh: 风里有两道很重的呼吸。
lines.en: Two heavy breaths travel in the wind.
I turn my back to it.

lines.zh: 这点重量，我两根手指就够。
lines.en: This much weight takes two fingers.
The ground groans when I pick things up.
An iron scrap; good for squeezing.
I squeeze it out of shape.
A blade on the ground; I don't need it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，影子罩住半片地。
lines.en: I bend and my shadow covers half the ground.
I pick it up, glance, then toss it.
This cloth will do to wipe my hands.
I grab a stone and crush it.
What's useful, I keep.
My eyes have changed color.
No shouting; I just come.
I've got your position locked.
This time I won't pull back.

lines.zh: 绿光从我的肩上冒出来。
lines.en: Green light rises off my shoulders.
The ground trembles under my feet.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就知道你要跑。
lines.en: The moment you turn, I know you'll run.
I fix on you and don't look away.
Your ki is far too weak.
This is not a warning.
I'm already moving.

lines.zh: 你身后那面墙，挡不住我。
lines.en: That wall behind you won't stop me.
It begins now, and you are not leaving.
I press in one step after another.

lines.zh: 你跑多远，我的影子就跟多远。
lines.en: However far you run, my shadow follows.
I don't go around; I come straight.
Hide in a cave and I'll take it apart.
Trees snap in my hands as I pass.
You're waiting for a chance; I won't give one.
At this distance I'm there in a blink.
I'm in no hurry, and you can't escape.
You looked up at me. Good.
My ki is surging up.
The moment you stop, I'm on you.
There's no exit on this side.
The further you back away, the more excited I get.

lines.zh: 我已经听不见别的声音。
lines.en: I can't hear anything else now.
Only a few paces left.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，地裂开一道缝。
lines.en: My fist lands and the ground splits.
One sweep of my palm throws you.
I grab you, then let go.
That one shattered your armor.

lines.zh: 膝盖压下来，你喘不出气。
lines.en: My knee comes down and you can't breathe.
Even a casual shove lands heavy.
A small ki blast leaves my palm.

lines.zh: 你侧身躲过，第二下没躲开。
lines.en: You dodge the first; not the second.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的脚踝甩出去。
lines.en: I catch your ankle and hurl you.
Honestly, that was half my strength.

lines.zh: 你落地时，尘土扑了一片。
lines.en: When you land, dust bursts up.
I close in step by step.
Wherever I hit, something cracks.
The sound of your breathing changed.
That one made me smile.
Can you still stand?

lines.zh: 我站在这里，草地立刻静了。
lines.en: I stand here, and the meadow goes quiet.

lines.zh: 这是我被放出来的地方。
lines.en: This is where they let me out.

lines.zh: 我抬头，第一次看这片天。
lines.en: I look up at this sky for the first time.
The stone under me crumbles.
I swing my arms and my joints pop.
A figure in the distance. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我的影子一下拉得很长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches out long.

lines.zh: 风停了，因为我挡住了它。
lines.en: The wind stopped because I blocked it.
Green light rises off my back.
I let out one slow breath.
The ground is still shaking.
I'm here, so this place should be in chaos.
I lift my chin and look around.

lines.zh: 这一带，没有能挡住我的东西。
lines.en: Nothing here can stop me.
I clench my fist.
Fire clings and burns. It's almost warm.

lines.zh: 水吞住我的脸，我挣得慢。
lines.en: Water closes over my face and I struggle slowly.

lines.zh: 爆风掀了我一下，皮都没破。
lines.en: The blast rocks me; my skin holds.

lines.zh: 那点小东西钉在我肩头。
lines.en: Something small sticks in my shoulder.
Something is boring its way inside me.

lines.zh: 肚子一空，力气就慢下来。
lines.en: An empty belly slows my strength.
Lightning runs down my back.

lines.zh: 这里没有地，我抓不住东西。
lines.en: No ground here; nothing to grip.
